answer: Downregulation predominantly drives the metabolic effects of CBD treatment in CRC cells. Differential expression of CBD_IC50 vs its vehicle control (DMSO), at padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.5, is dominated by downregulated genes: 217 up vs 462 down (primary). The serum-starvation sensitivity contrast (CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h vs DMSO_Serum_starvation) is likewise down-dominated: 1121 up vs 1635 down. This down > up direction is robust to the overdispersion assumption (down > up at every tested dispersion phi in {0.002, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1} in both contrasts). Caveat: the formal GO Biological Process enrichment could not be executed in this offline environment (no R/clusterProfiler/org.Hs.eg.db, no network, no gene->GO-BP mapping), so the metabolic attribution is inferred from the consistent, robust DE direction; no GO terms or enrichment p-values are reported.
